stories.title: An immigration and enforcement officer shoots and kills a woman in Minneapolis
stories.summary: An officer with Immigration and Customs Enforcement shot and killed a woman during the Trump administrations' latest immigration crackdown in Minneapolis.

stories.title: Denmark is telling President Trump to stop threatening to seize Greenland
stories.summary: Politicians in Denmark are dealing with widespread fears over U.S. officials' statements about taking over the Danish territory of Greenland. President Trump said it's crucial for security interests.

stories.title: At CES, the world's biggest tech companies hope to make a splash
stories.summary: At this year's CES convention in Las Vegas, the world's biggest consumer technology companies are hoping to make a splash, showcasing new chips, robots and AI-enabled devices.

stories.title: Aldrich Ames, CIA officer who spied for Soviet Union, has died at 84
stories.summary: One of the most notorious spies in U.S. history, Aldrich Ames, died on Tuesday at the age of 84. As a CIA officer, Ames sold highly classified secrets to the Soviet Union starting in the mid 1980s.

stories.title: Women's para ice hockey edges closer to its own Paralympic stage
stories.summary: When the Paralympics begin in Italy, one sport that won't be in the competition is women's para ice hockey. But after a successful World Championships, players hope it could be added in the future.

stories.title: Old and new faces reach the Billboard Hot 100 charts
stories.summary: After a rush of holiday-themed music, a sweep of new pop songs move up the chart.
